metaDescription: Order custom heat transfer outerwear for your team or event. Durable decoration on fleece jackets & vests. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Heat transfer decoration offers a smooth, durable finish that maintains the soft feel of fleece and performance fabrics. Ideal for full-color logos or detailed designs, this method works exceptionally well on polyester and blended outerwear like the Men's The North Face® Aim Full-Zip Fleece Jacket or the Ladies' Eddie Bauer® Dash Full-Zip Fleece Jacket. Whether you're outfitting a corporate team or a safety crew, heat transfer provides crisp, vibrant branding that won't crack or peel with regular wear.
heroAltText: Custom heat transfer outerwear featuring a full-color logo on a fleece jacket
